title: Full Motion vs Fixed TV Mounts
prompt: Wide-angle modern living room hero. A large flat-panel TV is mounted on a clean light-painted accent wall via a clearly visible full-motion articulating mount, with the TV swiveled and extended a few inches off the wall so the cantilever arm and pivot joint are unmistakable behind the screen. The room shows two distinct seating zones — a sofa centered on the wall and an angled lounge chair off to one side — implying the need for adjustability. Light walnut floor, woven rug, simple low media console below the TV. Soft natural daylight from camera-right. Medium-wide composition, eye-level. Mid-century-contemporary palette.

title: Is a Full Motion TV Mount Worth It
prompt: Lived-in modern living room hero. A flat-panel TV on a full-motion mount is extended out from the wall and swiveled toward a deep sectional sofa positioned off-center, as if pulled into a viewing position. Bracket arm visible behind the TV. A coffee mug and an open book sit on the coffee table in the foreground, suggesting someone has just settled in. Warm golden-hour daylight from a window camera-left, soft shadows. Hardwood floor, ribbed linen sofa, simple bookshelf in the background. Medium-wide composition, slightly low angle. Calm, evening mood.
